findings.title: Completion makes the order traversable.
findings.claim: Completion makes the religious order perceptible as navigable guidance: it can continue carrying followers through differentiated paths toward peace, emergence, light, and straightness.
findings.mechanism: The focus completion and dīn carriers return through the exact 5:16 sequence of following, approval, paths, peace, emergence, illumination, and a straight road; the HFT trace changes completion from a static object into an adequate route.
findings.reader_payoff: The completion statement gains motion and usability: what is complete can still guide continued movement.
findings.containment: This is an attributed, qualified HFT revision with a live alternative that completion is static and the route imagery belongs only to 5:16; unresolved branches remain unglossed.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT anchor pair and focus branches support the contact, but the route mechanism is legacy-unbound and cross-context.

findings.title: The focus prohibition and fear pair form an exploratory threshold topology.
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the focus's prohibition and directed fear transfer into a micro-topology of threshold obedience: rightly directed fear governs entry, while refusal can turn an offered protected domain into a barred one.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers for protected boundary at 5:3:1:1 and directed fear at 5:3:38:1 and 5:3:39:2 return through the later sequence of holy place, gate, fear, victory, refusal, sitting, and spatial prohibition from 5:21, 5:23, 5:24, and 5:26.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus boundary becomes perceptible as an obedience threshold whose status depends on how fear and entry are governed.
findings.containment: This remains an exploratory analogy between ingestion and territorial entry, not an identity of dietary and territorial rules; the exact HFT trace is attributed and unresolved branches remain unglossed.

epistemic.reason: The HFT outlier supplies complete coordinates and a stated exploratory confidence, but most context branches are unresolved and the cross-domain transfer is explicitly surprising.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: korunan yer ve ona bağlı kullanım çevresi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kutsal sayılan şehir veya bölge, sınırları ve yakın çevresiyle birlikte korunmuş mekândır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus prohibition carrier supplies the protected-boundary image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The holy place offered for entry at 5:21:4 supplies a later protected spatial threshold.
branch_activations.activation: The protected-place branch returns to the focus prohibition through a shared boundary relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The food boundary can be perceived as one instance of a guarded threshold.
branch_activations.boundary: The analogy does not equate the protected place with food or claim a shared legal rule.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: korku duyma

branch_activations.carrier: The paired focus fear forms supply directed fear and its opposed social object.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Fear before the gate and the community's refusal to enter provide the later threshold pressure.
branch_activations.activation: The focus redirection of fear meets a later entry decision, making fear part of threshold obedience.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Rightly governed fear can regulate whether a boundary is crossed.
branch_activations.boundary: The outlier does not claim that fear is always a reliable guide or that refusal has one universal cause.

branch_activations.carrier: A purified place supplies the later bounded destination that should be entered.

branch_activations.activation: The offered destination is read as a threshold whose crossing is governed by boundary and fear.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Entry becomes a test of obedient relation to a protected domain.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is unresolved and no lexical descriptor is added.

branch_activations.carrier: Returning away from the destination supplies reversal at the threshold.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus boundary and fear pair supply the rule-governed threshold contact.
branch_activations.activation: Reversal is read as the bodily counterpart to refusing or mishandling a governed crossing.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Threshold obedience includes the possibility of turning back from the offered domain.
branch_activations.boundary: This remains an attributed role and does not infer a settled motive for the reversal.

branch_activations.carrier: Turning one's back supplies the bodily action of refusing entry.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus prohibition and fear redirection supply the governing boundary relation.
branch_activations.activation: The refusal gesture returns to the focus as a failure to cross a protected threshold under proper direction.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The outlier can describe refusal as a bodily displacement from obedience.
branch_activations.boundary: No unresolved gloss is invented and no general moral diagnosis is attached to the gesture.

branch_activations.carrier: Anticipatory fear supplies the pressure under which the gate decision is made.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus's opposed fear commands supply a directed-fear comparison.
branch_activations.activation: The later fear before entry returns to the focus as a test of which object governs action.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Fear is positioned as a threshold control variable.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch remains unresolved and the analogy is explicitly exploratory.

branch_activations.carrier: A literal entrance supplies the later pericope's decisive threshold.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus protected-boundary and fear carriers supply the returned threshold frame.
branch_activations.activation: The gate gives the abstract boundary and fear pair a concrete crossing site.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Obedience is made visible as an entry act at a guarded opening.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved branch is not given a lexical gloss and the food-entry analogy remains bounded.

branch_activations.carrier: Overcoming force supplies the promised result of crossing under rightly governed fear.

branch_activations.activation: Victory becomes the result attached to crossing the threshold under the proper governing fear.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The outlier links obedience at the boundary with a changed outcome.
branch_activations.boundary: No lexical resolution or guaranteed outcome is asserted beyond the HFT role.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Crossing is governed by reliance rather than by the social fear rejected in the focus.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved branch is retained only as an attributed alternative control principle.

branch_activations.boundary: The branch remains unresolved and the outlier does not claim that all inaction has this meaning.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Threshold status can change after refusal, completing the exploratory topology.
branch_activations.boundary: The repeated branch does not prove that dietary prohibition changes in the same way; the relation remains analogical.
